title: Monsky Matrix and 2-Selmer rank
summary: In this article, we produce infinite families of non-congruent numbers in the residue class of $1,2,$ and $3$ modulo $8$ with arbitrarily many triples or quadruples prime factors. In short, we use Monsky matrix to show that the $2$-Selmer rank of the corresponding congruent number elliptic curve is zero. We also establish some quantitative results to conclude that each such family contains infinitely many non-congruent numbers.
